laws.law: Provenance — every governing artifact carries evidence_basis: forward|backtest|provisional; provisional never displayed as proven
Null Twin — no book without a named benchmark; every scorecard line is Δ-vs-null
Admission — markets via M0-M5, families via F0-F4; no other door
Contracts — schema per store; producer→consumer registry; cycle-validated; failure = red light
Cost Truth per venue — 2× friction bar uses the venue's own measured round-trip, never crypto's
Attention Budget — API/runner/bytes are allocated resources with monthly audit
Pre-Registered Death — every experiment declares kill criterion before logging starts
Utilization measured — idle capital priced (BENCH_CASH yield); armed-never-deployed is a finding
